newsitem.title: JAPAN: Key Dec JGB futures end down for 3rd straight day.
newsitem.headline: Key Dec JGB futures end down for 3rd straight day.

text.p: The key December Japanese government bond (JGB) futures contract ended Friday's Tokyo session sharply down as a correction continued, traders said.
After hitting an all-time intraday high for any benchmark contract of 126.52 on Wednesday morning, the December has experienced a sharp downturn, plunging for the third straight session.

It closed down 0.79 at 123.96, but off its intraday low of 123.55. Broad-based selling in cash JGBs by investors was detected, while some dealers were seen buying the December futures contract on dips, traders said.
